references.purpose: Symbol roots participate in canonical addressing.

semantics.addressing_rule: Symbol addressing uses semantic grammar and does not become unrestricted filesystem addressing.
semantics.authority_rule: Namespace existence does not grant read/write/invoke authority.
semantics.identity_rule: Each reserved root/family has explicit canonical namespace identity and owner.
semantics.mount_rule: Namespace registry resolves a root to its declared semantic owner/mount semantics.
semantics.path_rule: Filesystem directory name does not create or own a namespace.
semantics.root_rule: A runtime root exists only when explicitly declared by canonical runtime semantics.
